zh.title: Norse Atlantic挪威營運子公司申請破產
zh.summary: Norse Atlantic挪威營運子公司因短期資金不足申請破產
body: Norse Atlantic的挪威營運子公司 Norse Atlantic Airways AS已申請破產。AeroTime報導，航空公司於2026年11月27日宣佈此事；該子公司未能籌得足以履行短期財務義務的資金。
破產程序已向挪威的 Agder District Court 提交。AeroTime報導指出，程序迄今尚未影響航空公司的上市母公司及其英國子公司。
AeroTime另報導，Norse Atlantic Airways於同一週稍早已執行最後航班，並停飛全數機隊。

en.title: Norse Atlantic's Norwegian Operating Subsidiary Files for Bankruptcy
en.summary: Norse Atlantic's Norwegian operating subsidiary filed for bankruptcy because it could not secure funds for short-term obligations.
body: Norse Atlantic’s Norwegian operating subsidiary, Norse Atlantic Airways AS, had filed for bankruptcy. AeroTime reported that the carrier announced the filing on November 27, 2026; the subsidiary was unable to secure enough funds to meet its short-term financial obligations.

The bankruptcy proceedings were filed at Agder District Court in Norway. AeroTime reported that the proceedings had so far not affected the airline’s publicly listed parent company or its UK subsidiary.
AeroTime also reported that Norse Atlantic Airways had operated its last flights and grounded its entire fleet earlier in the same week.

zh.title: 星宇航空決議辦理現金增資發行3億股 募資主要用於償還銀行借款
zh.summary: 星宇航空公告現金增資案，預計發行3億股，募資主要用於償還銀行借款。
body: 星宇航空公告現金增資案，預計發行3億股，每股發行價格為15.5元。按發行價格計算，募資總額約新臺幣46.5億元，主要用於償還銀行借款。
公司表示，此次增資將透過員工認購、原股東認購及公開銷售3種方式辦理。員工認購部分保留發行股數的10%、共3000萬股；原股東將按認股基準日持股比例認購80%、約2.4億股；另提撥發行新股的10%、共3000萬股對外公開承銷。

en.title: Starlux Airlines plans a 300 million-share capital increase mainly to repay bank loans
en.summary: Starlux Airlines plans a 300 million-share capital increase, with proceeds mainly for bank-loan repayment.
body: Starlux Airlines announced a cash capital increase, planning to issue 300 million shares at NT$15.5 each. At that price, the offering is expected to raise about NT$4.65 billion, mainly for repayment of bank loans.

The company said the issue will be handled through employee subscriptions, subscriptions by existing shareholders and a public sale. Employees are to have 30 million shares, or 10% of the issue, reserved for subscription. Existing shareholders are set to subscribe for about 240 million shares, or 80%, in proportion to their holdings on the subscription record date. Another 30 million shares, or 10%, will be offered through public underwriting.

zh.title: 五起獨立航空事件彙整：衝出跑道、跑道偏出及風擋裂痕
zh.summary: Fedex MD-11在Miami降落時衝出跑道，另有四起獨立航空事件
body: 以下五起航空事件彼此獨立，沒有資料指出它們互相關聯。
1. Fedex 的 MD-11（ICAO機型代碼MD11）於2026年11月25日在Miami降落時衝出跑道。
2. Western Global 的波音747-400（ICAO機型代碼B744）於2026年11月25日在Tokyo反向滑行（backtrack）時發生跑道偏出。
3. Eastern 的波音777-200（ICAO機型代碼B772）於2026年11月25日在大西洋上空出現風擋裂痕。
4. France B773（波音777-300，ICAO機型代碼B773）於2026年11月25日在Paris附近出現引擎電子控制問題。
5. THY 的波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於2026年11月25日在Batumi發生多次雷擊。

en.title: Five independent aviation events: a roundup of runway and aircraft incidents
en.summary: Fedex MD-11 overran a runway at Miami; four other independent aviation events were reported.
body: The five events are independent, with no stated relationship between them.
1. Fedex's MD-11 (ICAO type code MD11) overran a runway on landing at Miami on Nov. 25, 2026.
2. Western Global's Boeing 747-400 (ICAO type code B744) had a runway excursion while backtracking at Tokyo on Nov. 25, 2026.
3. Eastern's Boeing 777-200 (ICAO type code B772) had a cracked windshield over the Atlantic on Nov. 25, 2026.
4. France B773 (Boeing 777-300, ICAO type code B773) had an engine electronic control problem near Paris on Nov. 25, 2026.
5. THY's Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) experienced multiple lightning strikes at Batumi on Nov. 25, 2026.

zh.title: Norse Atlantic挪威營運子公司將聲請破產 所有航班取消
zh.summary: Norse Atlantic挪威營運子公司將聲請破產，所有航班已取消。
body: Norse Atlantic Airways於11月27日確認，其挪威營運子公司將聲請破產；在籌措足以維持航空公司營運的資金未果後，Norse Atlantic Airways AS 董事會已決定向挪威的 Agder District Court 提出破產聲請。
這項破產決定適用於 Norse Atlantic 的挪威營運公司，而非整個航空集團；上市母公司 Norse Atlantic ASA 與英國營運子公司不在已宣佈的破產程序之列。Norse Atlantic 已取消所有航班並停止售票，已有訂位的旅客可能需要另作旅行安排；航班目前尚無確認的恢復日期。

en.title: Norse Atlantic’s Norwegian subsidiary to file for bankruptcy; all flights cancelled
en.summary: Norse Atlantic's Norwegian subsidiary is to file for bankruptcy; all flights are cancelled and ticket sales have stopped.
body: Norse Atlantic Airways confirmed on 27 November that its Norwegian operating subsidiary is to file for bankruptcy after attempts to secure enough funding to keep the airline flying failed. The board of Norse Atlantic Airways AS has decided to file a bankruptcy petition with Agder District Court in Norway.

The bankruptcy decision applies to Norse Atlantic’s Norwegian operating company, not the entire airline group. Norse Atlantic ASA and the UK operating subsidiary are not included in the announced proceedings. Norse Atlantic has cancelled all flights and stopped selling tickets, leaving passengers with existing bookings facing the prospect of having to make alternative travel arrangements. No date has been confirmed for flights to resume.

zh.title: 易捷航空空中巴士A321neo飛行兩分鐘後引擎失速並轉降
zh.summary: 易捷航空空中巴士A321neo轉降；備用機已派出接送乘客前往目的地。
body: Simple Flying報導，易捷航空一架空中巴士A321neo（ICAO機型代碼A21N）在飛行兩分鐘後發生引擎失速，隨後轉降。Simple Flying另報導該航班延誤六小時。
The Aviation Herald報導，易捷航空A21N於2026年11月26日在愛丁堡發生飛行中引擎關閉事件。Simple Flying表示，該機仍停在愛丁堡地面，易捷航空已派出備用飛機，讓乘客前往目的地。

en.title: easyJet Airbus A321neo Diverts After Engine Stall Two Minutes Into Flight
en.summary: easyJet's Airbus A321neo diverted; a spare jet was sent to get passengers to their destination.
body: Simple Flying reported that an easyJet Airbus A321neo (ICAO type code A21N) diverted after an engine stall two minutes into the flight. It also reported a six-hour delay for the flight.

The Aviation Herald reported an in-flight engine shutdown involving an easyJet A21N at Edinburgh on Nov. 26, 2026. Simple Flying said the aircraft remained on the ground in Edinburgh and that easyJet had dispatched a spare jet to get the passengers to their destination.
